rare_events.title: Locust swarm
rare_events.text: In dry weather a swarm can sweep over the farms and strip the crops.
rare_events.counter: Farms within two tiles of forest are spared (birds eat the locusts). Tree frogs stop swarms entirely.

rare_events.title: Algal bloom
rare_events.text: In summer, farm runoff and muddy water feed a bloom that suffocates fish.
rare_events.counter: Keep the coast clear: forest on slopes, restore bare land, don't over-farm one valley.

rare_events.title: King tide
rare_events.text: A rare surge of sea water floods low coastal land in the rainy season.
rare_events.counter: Coastal forest acts like a mangrove belt: land next to forest is protected.
